$comment: Plugin-scope MCP for the marketing pack. Per-subagent inline 'mcpServers' frontmatter is ignored when an agent ships inside a plugin (see council-and-network-config.md §2), so the network researchers' servers are declared here instead. Keys are read from the environment via ${VAR} interpolation — never hardcode them. After installing this plugin, run /mcp to confirm the servers connect and the exact tool names (mcp__tavily__*, mcp__dataforseo__*).
